title: Listening Practice Test 05 – Human Resources & Recruitment
description: Đề luyện Listening theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 26 câu: Part 1 (2) · Part 2 (6) · Part 3 (9, có câu hỏi hàm ý và biểu đồ) · Part 4 (9). Chủ đề: nhân sự, phỏng vấn, tuyển dụng, đào tạo nhân viên mới.

groups.transcript:
(A) A man is shaking hands with a woman.
(B) Two people are facing each other across a table.
(C) A woman is writing on a whiteboard.
(D) Some chairs are being carried into a room.

options.A: A man is shaking hands with a woman.
options.B: Two people are facing each other across a table.
options.C: A woman is writing on a whiteboard.
options.D: Some chairs are being carried into a room.

questions.explanation: Hai người ngồi đối diện nhau qua một chiếc bàn (giống buổi phỏng vấn) → (B). Không bắt tay (A), không có bảng trắng (C), không ai khiêng ghế (D).

groups.transcript:
(A) A worker is putting up a poster.
(B) Some people are seated on a bench.
(C) A plant is being watered.
(D) Some notices have been posted on a board.

options.A: A worker is putting up a poster.
options.B: Some people are seated on a bench.
options.D: Some notices have been posted on a board.

questions.explanation: Các thông báo đã được ghim sẵn lên bảng → (D) 'have been posted'. Ảnh không có người nên (A), (B), (C) đều sai.

groups.transcript:
Who's interviewing the job applicants this afternoon?
(A) Mr. Brooks and I are.
(B) About ten applications.
(C) In the afternoon paper.

questions.explanation: Who → người: 'Mr. Brooks and I are (interviewing)'. (B) bẫy 'applicants' – 'applications'; (C) lặp 'afternoon'.

groups.transcript:
Has the new accountant started yet?
(A) An account number.
(B) At the start of the meeting.
(C) Not until next Monday.

options.B: At the start of the meeting.

questions.explanation: Hỏi kế toán mới đã bắt đầu làm chưa → 'Phải đến thứ Hai tới'. (A) bẫy 'accountant' – 'account'; (B) lặp 'start'.

groups.transcript:
Why don't you apply for the manager position?
(A) Our manager's office.
(B) I'm not sure I'm qualified.
(C) I applied some sunscreen.

questions.explanation: 'Why don't you…?' là lời khuyên/gợi ý → đáp lại bằng sự do dự 'Tôi không chắc mình đủ năng lực'. (A) lặp 'manager'; (C) 'apply' với nghĩa 'bôi, thoa'.

groups.transcript:
How many people will attend the orientation?
(A) About fifteen new employees.
(B) In the training room.
(C) An orientation packet.

questions.explanation: How many → số lượng. (B) trả lời Where; (C) lặp từ 'orientation'.

groups.transcript:
You've reviewed the résumés, haven't you?
(A) The meeting resumed at three.
(B) Not all of them yet.
(C) It got a positive review.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi đuôi xác nhận đã xem hồ sơ chưa → 'Chưa xem hết'. (A) bẫy âm 'résumés' – 'resumed'; (C) lặp 'review'.

groups.transcript:
Would you rather work from home or at the office?
(A) Yes, I would.
(B) It's a nice home.
(C) I'm more productive at the office.

options.C: I'm more productive at the office.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn → chọn làm ở văn phòng kèm lý do. (A) Yes/No không phù hợp; (B) lặp 'home'.

groups.transcript:
M: Hello, this is Jason Lee. I received an e-mail inviting me to interview for the graphic designer position.
W: Yes, Mr. Lee. Thanks for calling back. We'd like to meet you on Thursday at ten a.m. Does that work for you?
M: Thursday morning is fine. Should I bring anything with me?
W: Yes, please bring a portfolio with at least five examples of your work. Also, the interview will include a short design test, so it'll take about two hours.
M: Understood. And where exactly is your office?
W: We're on the eighth floor of the Carlton Building. When you arrive, just check in with the security guard in the lobby.

questions.content: What position has the man applied for?
questions.explanation: '…invite me to interview for the graphic designer position.' (A) là người anh cần gặp ở sảnh.

questions.content: What is the man asked to bring?
questions.explanation: 'Please bring a portfolio with at least five examples of your work' → mẫu tác phẩm (samples of his work).

questions.content: What does the woman say about the interview?
questions.explanation: 'The interview will include a short design test, so it'll take about two hours.' (D) sai vì mất khoảng hai tiếng.

groups.transcript:
W: Tom, I just saw the schedule for next month. Three people from our customer service team will be on vacation during the same week.
M: That's the week we launch the new mobile app. We'll probably get a lot of calls.
W: Exactly. Should we ask one of them to change their vacation dates?
M: Well, they requested those days back in January.
W: You're right. Then let's hire a couple of temporary workers. I'll contact the staffing agency today.
M: Good idea. I can train them myself the week before.

questions.content: What problem are the speakers discussing?

options.C: A lack of staff during a busy week

questions.explanation: Ba nhân viên nghỉ phép cùng tuần ra mắt ứng dụng – tuần sẽ có nhiều cuộc gọi → thiếu người vào tuần bận rộn.

questions.content: What does the man imply when he says, “they requested those days back in January”?

options.B: It would be unfair to change the employees' plans.
options.C: He did not see the requests.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: nhân viên đã xin nghỉ từ tháng Một → không nên bắt họ đổi lịch. Người phụ nữ đồng ý 'You're right' và chọn thuê nhân viên tạm thời.

questions.content: What will the woman do today?

options.D: Get in touch with a staffing agency

questions.explanation: 'I'll contact the staffing agency today.' (A) là việc người đàn ông sẽ làm vào tuần trước đó.

groups.transcript:
W: Mr. Carter, one of the candidates for the sales position just called. She has a doctor's appointment on Friday morning and asked if she could come in the afternoon instead.
M: Which candidate is that?
W: The one who's scheduled to come in first.
M: I see. Well, David Novak told me he can't come on Friday at all, so just give her his time slot.
W: OK. I'll call her back and update the schedule. Should I also let the rest of the interview panel know?
M: Yes, please e-mail everyone the revised schedule.

questions.content: What kind of position are the candidates applying for?
questions.explanation: '…one of the candidates for the sales position.'

questions.content: Look at the graphic. Who called the woman?
questions.explanation: Người gọi là ứng viên 'scheduled to come in first' – theo lịch, người phỏng vấn đầu tiên (9:00) là Maria Gomez.

questions.content: What will the woman send to the interview panel?
questions.explanation: 'Please e-mail everyone the revised schedule.'

groups.transcript: Good morning, and welcome to your first day at Norland Pharmaceuticals. I'm Grace Liu, the director of human resources. This morning you'll receive your employee ID badges and complete some paperwork. After lunch, which will be served in the cafeteria on the ground floor, your team leaders will take you on a tour of the laboratories. Before we begin, please make sure your mobile phones are turned off. Now, I'd like to show you a short video about the history of our company.

questions.content: Who most likely are the listeners?
questions.explanation: 'Welcome to your first day at Norland Pharmaceuticals', nhận thẻ nhân viên → nhân viên mới.
'After lunch, which will be served in the cafeteria on the ground floor…'

questions.content: What will the listeners most likely do next?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối: 'Now, I'd like to show you a short video about the history of our company.'

groups.transcript: Hi, Ms. Alvarez. This is Robert Shaw from Elmwood Engineering. Thank you for coming in for your interview last week. I'm pleased to tell you that we'd like to offer you the position of project coordinator. I've attached the offer letter to an e-mail I sent you this morning. It includes the salary and benefits we discussed. Now, I know you mentioned you're considering another offer. We're flexible about the start date. Please let me know your decision by the end of next week.

questions.explanation: 'We'd like to offer you the position of project coordinator.'

questions.content: What has the speaker sent by e-mail?
questions.explanation: Thư mời nhận việc được đính kèm e-mail, 'It includes the salary and benefits we discussed.'

questions.content: Why does the speaker say, “We're flexible about the start date”?

options.A: To encourage the listener to accept the offer
options.B: To explain a delay in a project
options.C: To ask the listener to start immediately

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: biết ứng viên đang cân nhắc nơi khác, công ty sẵn sàng linh hoạt ngày bắt đầu → thuyết phục cô ấy nhận lời.

groups.intro: excerpt from a meeting and chart
groups.transcript: Let's look at the number of job applications we've received this year. As you can see, the number dropped sharply in one month. That was the month our online job portal was down for maintenance. The good news is that last month we received the most applications ever, thanks to our new social media advertising. Going forward, I'd like each department manager to write a short description of what it's like to work on their team. We'll post those descriptions on our careers page.

questions.content: Look at the graphic. When was the job portal unavailable?
questions.explanation: Số hồ sơ giảm mạnh vào tháng cổng tuyển dụng bảo trì; biểu đồ cho thấy tháng thấp nhất là March (38).

questions.content: According to the speaker, what led to last month's increase?
questions.explanation: '…thanks to our new social media advertising.'

questions.content: What are department managers asked to do?
questions.explanation: 'I'd like each department manager to write a short description of what it's like to work on their team.' (B) là việc công ty sẽ làm sau đó.
